To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the expertise reversal effect is a robust phenomenon, which has been replicated in several studies with different instructional techniques; (b) the effect is not restricted to the use of worked examples, but also appears in the use of animations and other instructional techniques; and (c) the effect is due to a shift in cognitive load, which is caused by a shift in the balance between extraneous and germane load.
the effects of the expertise reversal effect depend on the nature of the instructional task, the instructional method, and the instructional material.
multimedia learning is effective when it is designed to reduce extraneous cognitive load and increase germane cognitive load.
